broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains correct. NFKC, lowercase, whitespace collapse to single space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No changes needed.

tokenizer.js remains as per spec. Calls injected normalize(text) once, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using exact regex. Returns empty array for no matches. Works with empty strings, punctuation, whitespace. No changes needed.

pipeline.js remains as implemented. It calls injected tokenize(text), builds frequencies with Object.create(null) to safely handle prototype names like 'constructor', and returns exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. No changes needed; ready for integration.
